brief.offering: Continuous SOC 2 compliance automation. Connects to a company's cloud infrastructure, monitors controls continuously, and produces audit-ready evidence.
brief.audience: Technical founders and heads of compliance at Series A-C fintech companies. Bought by people who have been through one painful audit already.
brief.tone: Precise, calm, credible. Understated rather than loud. The reader is technical and allergic to marketing language.

constraints.text: no blue - our competitor is blue
no countdown timers or fake urgency

design_system.atmosphere: A calm control environment informed by audit working papers, evidence folders, and chain-of-custody records. Pale mineral surfaces, carbon-copy brown, and restrained evidence-tab ochre make SOC 2 automation feel maintained and inspectable rather than marketed. The overall impression is precise, durable, and ready for scrutiny.
design_system.signature: The memorable element is a continuous ochre evidence tape labeled with real SOC 2 control IDs, cloud sources, collection times, and verification states.
key_characteristics: Ochre is reserved for the evidence tape, selected proof, and primary-action focus states; it is never used as ambient decoration.
SOC 2 control IDs, source names, timestamps, and verification states replace arbitrary numbering and generic eyebrows.
Headings use condensed, form-like typography while body copy remains highly legible and conversationally restrained.
Product captures are presented as audit exhibits with provenance labels, never as floating devices or perspective mockups.
Rules and dashed marks appear only when they communicate evidence lineage, collection boundaries, or verification state.
Buttons and inputs have compact corners; pill shapes are prohibited except for machine states that are genuinely binary.
There are no gradients, decorative glows, stock photos of people, countdown timers, or urgency devices.

design_system.radius_full_allowed: Only tiny live-monitoring indicators and binary verified or failed state markers may be fully round; buttons, tags, cards, and inputs may not.
design_system.imagery_treatment: Use only real product UI, infrastructure diagrams, and evidence artifacts—never stock photos of people. Present screenshots front-on as filed exhibits on the card color, with crisp borders and mono provenance labels for source, SOC 2 control, collector, and timestamp; avoid gradients, glass effects, device frames, and perspective tilt.
design_system.motion: Standard entrances fade while translating upward 6px over 180ms with an ease-out curve. In the signature evidence tape, a single ochre verification tick may travel to the next checkpoint over 320ms when evidence refreshes; nothing loops continuously. Hover and focus transitions last 120ms, and reduced-motion mode removes translation and checkpoint travel.
